votes.motion: Approve the variances requested for 37 Spring Street (wetland and adjoining-well offsets), with the conditions of the required deed notifications and well testing.
votes.quote: on motion by normandin and second by jewell, the variances were approved with the condition of the required deed notifications and well testing. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances requested for 152 Sunny Hill Road (cellar wall offset, sieve analysis, pervious soil depth).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by watters, the variances were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances requested for 290 New West Townsend Road (well and wetland offsets) with a poly barrier.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by normandin and second by watters, the variances were approved with a poly barrier. all in favor.

votes.motion: Grant the variance requested for 919 Northfield Road (offset to groundwater from 4 feet to 3 feet).
votes.quote: motion by watters and second by normandin, the variance was granted. all in favor.
having no further matters before the board and on motion fortin and seconded by jewell, the meeting was adjourned at 7:55 pm, all in favor.

decisions.decision: For 37 Spring Street, the Board requires a deed notification for the GeoMat system and Jet Tank, plus a two bedroom deed restriction.
decisions.quote: a deed notification for the use of the geomat system, jet tank as well as a two bedroom deed restriction are required.

decisions.decision: For 37 Spring Street, the Board requires testing of the surrounding wells and the on-site well after installation, and yearly testing of the on-site well.
decisions.quote: once the system is installed the board is requiring testing of the surrounding wells and the well on the property.
